Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring a state route number 2 route development plan.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to a state route number 2 route development plan;creating a new section; making an appropriation; and providing anexpiration date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department of transportation shallconduct a state route number 2 route development plan that willidentify essential improvements needed between the port ofEverett/Naval Station and approaching the state route number 9interchange near the city of Snohomish.

The sum of four hundred thousand dollars, oras much thereof as may be necessary, is appropriated for the bienniumending June 30, 2011, from the multimodal transportation account to thedepartment of transportation for the purposes of section 1 of this act.
